---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for OneToThree
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
---

### Problem / motivation
What problem does this solve, or what would it improve? Is it related to a
frustration you're having? ("I'm always frustrated when …")

### Proposed solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

### Alternatives considered
Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Scope
- Which part(s)? client (web/Android/desktop) / server / self-host (Lite) / docs
- Does it affect the E2EE / security model? (if unsure, say so)

### Additional context
Mockups, links, or any other context.
